nodes.label: Gross global Scope 1 GHG emissions
nodes.description: Gross global Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions in metric tons of CO2 equivalent. Direct combustion stationary mobile process fugitive.

nodes.label: Scope 2 GHG emissions
nodes.description: Gross global Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions from purchased electricity steam heat cooling. Location-based and market-based.

nodes.label: Total energy consumed
nodes.description: Total energy consumed as sum of fuel consumption and purchased energy. Renewable and non-renewable sources. Gigajoules terajoules.

nodes.label: Percentage of energy from renewable sources
nodes.description: Percentage of total energy consumption from renewable sources. Solar wind hydro geothermal biomass. Renewable energy percentage.

nodes.label: Total water withdrawn
nodes.description: Total water withdrawn from all sources. Municipal water groundwater surface water rainwater. Freshwater and other water.

nodes.label: Water withdrawn in high water stress areas
nodes.description: Total water withdrawn from facilities in locations with High or Extremely High Baseline Water Stress per WRI Aqueduct tool.

nodes.label: Amount of hazardous waste generated
nodes.description: Total weight of hazardous waste generated. Regulated waste manifest tracked hazardous materials.

nodes.label: Air quality emissions (NOx, SOx, particulates)
nodes.description: Air emissions including nitrogen oxides NOx sulfur oxides SOx particulate matter PM2.5 PM10 volatile organic compounds. Criteria pollutants air quality.
